title: Lipids do not support stand-alone, transportable risk stratification for diabetic retinopathy: a four-layer evaluation, with a cautionary finding on outcome misclassification
description: Analysis code, figure/table-generation scripts and de-identified aggregate outputs for a four-layer evaluation of whether lipids can support a stand-alone, transportable diabetic-retinopathy risk tool. The repository contains no manuscript text and no individual-level data. Individual-level clinical records are held under the ethics approval described in the manuscript (Bengbu First People's Hospital, approval BBYY2023072) and are not shared.
